name: Run agent shell commands on the server with the Local backend
description: An AI agent runs shell commands with the Local execution backend, which runs them directly on the ByteChef server instead of in a Docker container. It shows that commands start in the agent workspace but can see its parent directory. Use it only on a trusted single-tenant installation.
shortDescription: Shell commands run on the server itself, starting in the agent workspace.
keyFeatures: Shell Tools with the Local execution backend
Working directory set to the agent workspace
PASS/FAIL report in the execution log
prerequisites: Server setting bytechef.ai.agent-utils.shell.enabled=true (BYTECHEF_AI_AGENT_UTILS_SHELL_ENABLED), which turns on Shell Tools
Server setting bytechef.ai.agent-utils.shell.allow-local=true (BYTECHEF_AI_AGENT_UTILS_SHELL_ALLOW_LOCAL), on a trusted single-tenant installation only
idealFor: Administrators of a trusted single-tenant ByteChef server who want agents to run commands without Docker.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Run in the workflow editor.
Run the checks: the AI Agent runs three shell commands on the server and reports what it can see.
Log the report: the Logger step prints the agent's PASS/FAIL table to the execution log.
